Germination Lab

The germination experiment was conducted by Dr Tao Luo (CSIRO) in 2025 as part of the GRDC long coleoptile wheat project, which was led by Dr Greg Rebetzke (CSIRO).

Two wheat cultivars were evaluated, Mace (commercial cultivar) and Mace18 (a long-coleoptile cultivar).

Seeds from a uniform size class (3.15–3.55 mm) were selected, and 25 seeds were placed in each Petri dish for germination under controlled environmental conditions.

There were eight constant temperatures from 5 to 40 °C, in 5 °C steps. At each temperature, seeds were exposed to six water potentials (0, −0.5, −1.0, −1.25, −1.5 and −1.75 MPa) set using PEG 6000 solutions.

Germinated seeds were counted daily over 14-day period.

2 Sensibility

Sensibility test of the hydrothermal germination model: SowingDate x Site x Soil x GerminationModel, 1988-2017.

GerminationModel compares the new GerminatingPhaseHydroThermal (HydroThermal) with the original GerminatingPhase (Original).

Box_SeedTemperature, Box_SeedWaterPotential and Box_WaterFactor show everaged seed-layer conditions on germination-phase (sowing day to germination day),over 30 years, to explain the Box_GerminationDAS results. WaterFactor exists only for the HydroThermal model.
